what: Rule requires all gh pr create to use create-pr.sh but design-log-publish intentionally uses raw gh pr create
scenario_or_breakage: Editors of design-log-publish.sh (in paths:) get a rule that contradicts the documented disposable-worktree PR path and may wrongly route through create-pr.sh (existing-PR fast-path / assignee / push semantics)
suggested_fix: Qualify Required pattern: create-pr.sh for interactive/implement PRs; exempt scripts/design-log-publish.sh (documented direct gh pr create --body-file on disposable branch)
